Whimsical Design Skill 1.0.0

- Introduced a skill focused on adding personality, delight, and creative expression to design work.
- Strictly not auto-applied; must only be used when creative direction or brand expression is explicitly required.
- Provides practical guidelines for achieving warmth and liveliness in designs via interaction, animation, color, and background depth.
- Encourages strong, intentional aesthetic decisions—avoiding generic or “safe” styles.
- Outlines clear examples and CSS recipes for adding “juice,” background texture, and craft to interfaces.
- Emphasizes judgment in application, ensuring that this approach is only used when it adds genuine value.
